snippet.title: Finding Polka - Official Nintendo Switch Announce Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives! Check out the latest Finding Polka trailer for this wholesome hidden object game. Finding Polka is coming to Nintendo Switch. It is already available on PC.
